SENSORIUM. [2] [Chim. m.]
Sudden headache with dimness of vision ; she had to be led to bed ; felt light-headed.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Chim. m.]
Sensation of lightness in head.
Sudden headache above eyes ; < on lying down.
Frontal headache with fulness in stomach and belching.
   

TEETH AND GUMS. [10] [Chim. m.]
Toothache ; < during eating.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Chim. m.]
Sore throat and swollen tonsils.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Chim. m.]
Diarrhœa accompanying worm fever.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Chim. m.]
Angina with stupor.
